parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database for which to enable SQL audit.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

parameters.name: IsRecall
parameters.description: Specifies whether to recall historical SQL statements for auditing.

parameters.name: RecallEndTimestamp
parameters.description:
The end time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
>The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: RecallStartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
